groups.description: The length of time for transitions and animations. Use an ease-in-out acceleration curve, and use the same duration for animations that occur simultaneously.

tokens.name: Short duration
tokens.description: The duration for small, quick changes like hover and focus states, and for elements that slide or emerge over part of the page, such as sidebars, menus, and dropdowns.

tokens.name: Medium duration
tokens.description: The duration for larger changes like expanding and collapsing containers, and for content that replaces or overlays the page, such as modals and toasts.
